reason: I already have a page on Instagram I order from, I know her, I pay a small deposit and the stuff comes. Paying 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes is almost double, and I don't know you yet, so why switch?
objection: The fees are too heavy next to the price of the item, and I would be paying up front to a new name I have never dealt with. My page already handles everything for me and I'm used to it.
would_change_my_mind: If a friend or my sister ordered from them and it came on time, and the total for a small item came out cheaper than my usual page, I would try one order.
